augmented_euler_target.name: E_cyc2,sep,X
augmented_euler_target.definition: direct_sum over admitted prime shells p of (C e_(p,2)) tensor H_sep,p, with ordered-pair labels retained in the coefficient graph
augmented_euler_target.adams_factor: e_(p,2) is the source-authorized second cyclic grade
augmented_euler_target.history_factor: H_sep,p is the completed rapid separation-density space containing every rho_g and all t-moments
augmented_euler_target.bare_cyclic_square_projection: forget H_sep,p after an explicitly declared moment functional; not faithful and not used to define the bridge

faithful_realization.reason: faithfulness comes from retained source coordinate, not from claiming density synthesis has zero kernel

minimality.bare_e_p2_insufficient: one scalar cannot retain the complete density or its moment jets
minimality.separation_history_sufficient: Laplace transform and every parameter jet factor through H_sep,p
minimality.claim: among the three previously listed viable architectures, this realizes Adams-two tensored with a retained separation-history module

required_conservative_extension.arithmetic_loop: extend A0 on each shell as A0,euler tensor I_Hsep, or provide a source-derived nontrivial history action
required_conservative_extension.incidence: define B_aug on e_(p,2) tensor rho_g into the conservative history carrier
required_conservative_extension.adjoint: derive B_aug^dagger from the augmented source and target pairings
required_conservative_extension.border: transport rho0,E,W,R without applying a bare cyclic-square scalar projection

normalization_boundary: No endpoint coefficient or p^-2/4 scalar is inserted into Q_X^sep. Such normalization belongs to the later conservative incidence/border comparison; inserting it here from the desired Schur value would be fitted.
disposition: A finite pair-to-cyclic-square bridge can be constructed without losing the shell density by augmenting Adams grade two with separation history and retaining its joint graph. This repairs the arithmetic carrier type in a faithful candidate architecture, but the old conservative cone has not adopted or extended to this augmented carrier.
